referenceSources.description:
This 1995 Chevrolet Camaro SCCA Trans Am race car features a striking red, white, and blue paint scheme with checkered side panels and the racing number 64 prominently displayed on the hood and doors. The Z28 model is equipped with gold mesh wheels, Goodyear tires, and a large rear wing, emphasizing its track-focused design.

Listed on Classic.com, the vehicle’s Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale appearance is documented alongside detailed specifications such as left-hand drive configuration, two-door body style, and TMU mileage status. Comparable listings highlight recent asking prices ranging from $15,995 to $30,000, providing market context for collectors and racers alike.
